text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Port is app/ports/news.py. Runtime bootstrap passes {rss: RssNewsProvider(), url: HtmlNewsProvider()}; no NewsSourceRegistry class.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Current HTML parser is _ArticleParser, not a ReadabilityExtractor class.
Safe HTTPS/DNS/redirect/size/type checks are module functions.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deterministic alias tagging happens inside provider normalization.
Sentiment runs separately after collection; AI failure leaves item without result.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Current fallback is direct typed HTTP inference on sanitized failure.document_text.
NewsExtractionAgent + five-tool orchestration remains P1 target, not runtime code.
